data.name: Arqam
data.gender_notes: Arqam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Writer, Recorder, Companion of the Prophet
data.long_meaning: Arqam is a historical Arabic name meaning 'writer' or 'recorder'. It is famously associated with Al-Arqam ibn Abi Al-Arqam, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ whose house was the first secret center of Islamic teachings in Makkah. The name Arqam carries the meaning “Writer, Recorder, Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Arqam usually hope their child will grow to embody writer, recorder, companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes silent strength, dedication, and devotion to the early mission of Islam.
data.etymology: Arqam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Writer, Recorder, Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arqam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ارقم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أرقم يعني العدد الكثير أو الكتاب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ارقم مشتق من الأرقام، وهو جمع رقم، ويعني العدد الكثير أو الكتاب. وقد ورد ذكر اسم ارقم في السنة النبوية، حيث كان أحد أصحاب النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم يسمى ارقم بن ثعلبة.

in_urdu.name: ارقم
in_urdu.meaning: ارقم کا مطلب ہے بہت سا شمار یا کتاب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارقم نام عربى جڑوں سے بنا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بہت سا شمار یا کتاب۔ یہ نام رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے صحابیوں میں سے ایک ارقم بن ثعلبہ کے نام سے مشہور ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अरक़म
in_hindi.meaning: अरक़म का अर्थ है बहुत सारा गिनना या पुस्तक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरक़म नाम अरबी मूल से है, जिसका अर्थ है बहुत सारा गिनना या पुस्तक। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के एक सहाबी अरक़म بن थअल्बा से जुड़ा है।

in_pashto.name: ارقم
in_pashto.meaning: ارقم د ډیرو شمېرو یا کتاب معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارقم نوم د عربي ريښو څخه جوړ شوی دی، چې د ډیرو شمېرو یا کتاب معنی لري. دا نوم د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د صحابيو په منځ کې يو ارقم بن ثعلبة سره مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Arqam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arqam is derived from the Arabic root 'R-Q-M', meaning 'much counting' or 'book'. It holds significant historical and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, being associated with Arqam ibn Thalabah, one of the companions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name symbolizes knowledge, recording, and the preservation of history.

celebrity_usage: Al-Arqam ibn Abi Al-Arqam (Companion of Prophet ﷺ)
data.cultural_impact: Arqam holds a significant place in Islamic history as the name of Al-Arqam ibn Abi Al-Arqam, a key figure in the early dissemination of Islamic teachings. His house in Makkah served as the first documented location for the covert study of Islam before it became an openly practiced religion. Arqam’s role as an early supporter and facilitator of Islam's growth reflects the importance of community and personal commitment to the faith during its formative period.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arqam holds a profound spiritual significance for Muslims because it is rooted in the actions of its namesake, who, through his dedication to the faith and provision of a safe space for learning, contributed to laying the foundations of the Islamic community and the dissemination of Islamic knowledge. It serves as a source of inspiration and reminder of the importance of encouraging spiritual growth, fostering communities of learning, and upholding a personal commitment to the teachings of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arqam signifies the 'steadfast one' or 'persevering one' in the struggle of faith. It is a reminder to remain steadfast in belief and actions, even in the face of adversity. This name inspires resilience and unwavering dedication to the path of righteousness.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Arqam ibn Abi Al-Arqam was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Arqam carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Arqam is mentioned in various hadiths and sira (biography) texts as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He is also mentioned as a participant in the Battle of Badr.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Arqam remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
